title: Bounded full approval cards
goal: Render the complete bounded card and expiry state in the companion
acceptance: Action, arguments, reason, pattern and remaining TTL visible
Expired or reconciled cards cannot offer a misleading decision
privacy: Repository-owned neutral fixtures; do not send private inputs to another inference host or enable services/devices without existing authorization.
validation: Run affected regressions across the changed boundary and applicable fast checks
Keep human/device acceptance and independent review distinct from fixture results
escalation: Stop on unclear ownership, missing prerequisites, privacy changes or uncertain external effects
Escalate repeated tool failures or inadequate context; no automatic cloud fallback
